[solution] ctr has no -p/--publish option (the mapping a Docker user expects is something
[solution] nerdctl or CNI's portmap plugin provides). The container started by plain 'ctr run'
[solution] has a network namespace of its own with only a loopback device, and a running
[solution] container's namespaces cannot be changed. So remove it and start it again in the
[solution] host's network namespace (--net-host): its server then listens on host port 8085.
[solution] waiting until the host gets an answer on port 8085...
[solution] done.
